items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Like they once said about Jack T. Gordon, every note that he ever played on the trombone meant something.

ctx.x: Well, is there something else of his?

I don't know. I don't know of anything else. Of course, everybody knows he's wearing candle lights, you know. There's whole tones again, you see. Yeah. He eucalyzed that great. And this is also a pair. One of his beautiful passages I like. stuff like He had to be a man with plenty, plenty feeling, plenty, I imagine basically he was a romantic man that says, you know, he had to be, because his music was beautiful. That's what made it so great. I think any music has to have some kind of feeling behind it. That's…
